InfoEdge OA – IITG

There were 40 MCQs divided into 4 sections (10 questions each). Everyone seemed to get a different set of questions.

My set had questions from Linear Algebra, ML, DL, and Programming. Overall, the questions were easy to medium difficulty, with some being quite theoretical and conceptual.

The total time limit was 1 hour.

The  OA usually covers quantitative aptitude, logical reasoning, and verbal ability. For technical roles, they also add a coding section, which might include a couple of DSA problems and some MCQs on computer science fundamentals like operating systems, DBMS, and networking. The aptitude questions are typically about speed and accuracy, so don't get stuck on one problem for too long. The coding questions are generally in the easy to medium range, focusing on common topics like arrays, strings, and sometimes hashmaps.
